ifDeleted.summary: s14 is the only place the audience watches the layoff happen: SJ, mid-bug, is let go on a scripted HR call and goes looking for a reason he cannot find. Almost every fact it delivers (severance, scored criteria, returns label, the unregistered computer, Brendan also fired, Marcus spared) is restated in s19, so the plot survives with one narrator bridge and two word swaps. What is lost is the play's most direct emotional turn for SJ; the firing becomes reported, not seen.
